name: ULAB Step-by-step Scraping Orchestrator
description: A complete, production-ready JSON prompt / spec that orchestrates step-by-step scraping of ulab.edu.bd and listed subdomains. It enforces validation after each step, removes error/bad-result

(records) before proceeding to the next approach, and logs failures with retry/fallback strategies. Use this JSON as the plan input to your orchestration engine (n8n, Airflow, custom runner) or as instructions for a Playwright-based scraper microservice.

metadata.author: UlabBot Plan
metadata.source_list_note: This local file contains discovered subdomains and should be read as the seed list. Provide the path above to the runner; if your runner expects a URL, map this local path accordingly.

user_agents: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36
Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 13_0) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.0 Safari/605.1.15

steps.name: Load seed subdomains
steps.description: Read /mnt/data/ulab.edu.bd subdomains.json and filter to prioritized Tiers.

steps.name: Fetch department homepages
steps.description: Visit each seed subdomain homepage to gather index links (faculty, programs, admission pages). Use Playwright to execute JS and bypass Cloudflare where possible.

fallback.description: Make a raw GET (requests) without JS and record response

steps.name: Prioritize discovered pages
steps.description: From discovered links, prioritize faculty pages, program/curriculum pages, admission pages, and registrar pages.

steps.name: Scrape faculty / staff pages
steps.description: Deep-scrape pages with faculty/staff lists and individual profiles. Use a combination of DOM selectors and micro-scrapers per department. Decode Cloudflare-obfuscated emails.

steps.name: Scrape program & curriculum pages
steps.description: Extract program metadata, course lists, course descriptions, credits and fees.

fallbacks.description: When course descriptions are not inline, follow each course detail link and scrape description.
If program PDF exists, download and parse text from PDF then extract program info.

steps.name: Scrape admissions & fee breakdown
steps.description: Focused scraping of admissions, application steps, fee tables and deadlines.

on_invalid.note: Admission pages can be re-checked later; keep record for manual review

steps.name: Validate, remove bad cells and decide next approach
steps.description: Run full validation across all 'clean.*' outputs. Any record that fails validation becomes a 'bad cell'. Bad cells are deleted from the pipeline before the next approach. For items marked removable=true, remove; for items marked removable=false, send to manual review queue.

steps.name: Fallback scraping attempts for pruned records
steps.description: For each bad cell where 'remove_from_next_steps' was false, attempt alternative scraping methods (PDF parse, site-search, different selectors). If fallback fails after configured retries, send to manual review.

attempts.name: pdf_parser
attempts.method: download any linked PDF on the source page, extract text with pdfminer or tika, then parse using same extractors

attempts.name: site_search
attempts.method: use site's internal search endpoint (if available) or site:ulab.edu.bd Google-like query via DuckDuckGo (if allowed by policy) to find the content

attempts.name: alternate_selectors
attempts.method: rerun Playwright with alternative list and item selectors and longer wait times (networkidle + extra 5s)

steps.name: Normalize, enrich and store final clean data
steps.description: Normalize fields (names, departments), enrich with vector embeddings, and persist to DBs.

steps.name: Index data for RAG and LLM use
steps.description: Chunk documents, generate embeddings (if not already), create vector indices and metadata for RAG retrieval.

steps.name: Monitoring, reporting and alerts
steps.description: Create dashboards and alerts for scraping health, bad-cell counts, and data drift.

bad_cell_policy.definition: A 'bad cell' is any scraped record failing schema validation, containing less than min_text_length characters in required fields, or having un-decodable critical fields (like email when required).

on_detect: append to bad_cells collection with metadata (source_url, step_id, reason, raw_html snapshot, attempts_count)
if marked_removable==true => delete record from pipeline and do not retry further
if marked_removable==false => route to fallback step (step-08) for retries

developer_notes.playwright_note: Use Playwright in stealth mode and rotate user agents; capture screenshots when page rendering fails
developer_notes.pdf_parsing_note: Use tika or pdfminer; after PDF text extraction, run same text-parsing pipeline to extract fields
developer_notes.manual_review_UI: Build a simple web UI to show bad_cells with original HTML snapshots and one-click actions: retry, edit, accept, discard
